audit.whatIsWrong: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability. It is used as the matchup-defining cooldown in roughly twenty strings — tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus, phases, every breakdown and half the report. Ambessa's real slots are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). spikes[1] also calls Public Execution 'a lunging displacement-execute'.
audit.why: Riot's Public Execution text is a blink to the farthest champion in a chosen line, a suppress, then a slam for damage and a stun — there is no execute. Repudiation is the real burst-absorber: she braces behind a shield and the slam deals more if it blocked non-minion damage. Drakehound's Step is an auto reset, so her combo opens with a wind-up, not a cast.
audit.corrected: Every 'Repeating Dashes' reference replaced with the real ability; Public Execution described as blink-suppress-stun at 1250 range on 130s; Repudiation's 18s shield named as the thing to bait before dumping Purge; the Drakehound's Step reset tell written into spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Ambessa / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Ambessa — five neutral rows that contradict the whys sitting next to them.
audit.why: The whys already describe the real shape and it matches the packet chart exactly: level 1 even, level 2 yours, 3 and 4-5 hers, 5-6 back to you, first item hers, late yours.
audit.corrected: Skill / Urgot / Ambessa / Ambessa / Urgot / Ambessa / Urgot, proposed as one group with the win[N] pairs and ratings. Difficulty pulled to 5/10 to match the 55.44% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown number anywhere, and the spikes describe a vague 'cooldown-reset combo'.
audit.why: Lacerate 13s, Repudiation 18s, Public Execution 130s at rank 1 are what make 'wait for the window' actionable.
audit.corrected: 13s, 18s and 130s written into the phases, spikes and the cooldowns breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] tells you to 'W-slow-walk out of her dash chain'.
audit.why: Purge slows Urgot himself while he fires — it is not an escape, it is the opposite.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to say Purge slows you and must not be started as a disengage.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' was a fabricated ability name threaded through about twenty strings on this page — the single biggest defect I found in this slice. Replaced with Public Execution where the field means her matchup-defining cooldown, and with Lacerate / Drakehound's Step where it means her mobility. NOT written: champ-data/_kits/_missing/urgot.json claims Ambessa sustains through Public Execution and needs Grievous Wounds.
